narrative: Material PL3__M7F9E1E9 exhibits irregular demand with mean daily demand of 23872.27 units (CV=0.58). Lead time analysis shows unstable behavior (mean=1.08 days, CV=0.99), with transport variability being the dominant factor (75.9% of variance). The optimized (r,Q) EOQ policy recommends a safety stock of 48,301 units (vs. SAP's 0), an order quantity of 67,955 units, and a reorder point of 74,179 units, achieving the 95% service level target within the 195,673-unit storage capacity. The marginal annual cost premium of $994.60 over the SAP baseline is fully justified by the elimination of stockout risk inherent in the zero-safety-stock configuration.
